Messages.Body:
I use Chain of Command to move Sonja Blue from my uncontrolled region
to my ready region. She bleeds successfully. Does she now:

1) Move to the bottom of my crypt, as per card text on CoC, or
2) Remove herself from play, as per her card text?

I'm guessing it's the latter, as CoC attempts to move her to the bottom
of the crypt, which activates Sonja's card text and removes her from
the game before she can get there.

John Eno
